atoms.b: Formulae are mathematical ((++equations theories)) used to show the relationship between two or more ((++variables numbers)).
For example, the formula to calculate the area of a rectangle is ((++A_=_𝘭𝘸 A𝘭_=_𝘸)), where <mat>A</mat> is the area, 𝘭 is the length and 𝘸 is the width.
Formulae are ((++always never)) true. If you know the formula to calculate the area of a rectangle, you can use it to calculate the ((++area price)) of any rectangle.
